name: OpenAI
notes: Auth: Authorization: Bearer. Base and /v1/chat/completions confirmed in API reference curl examples. Models list Responses API as primary surface; Chat Completions still documented. Also gpt-6.1-terra. Optional OpenAI-Organization / OpenAI-Project headers.

name: Anthropic (Claude)
notes: Native Messages API adapter (x-api-key + anthropic-version).

name: Google Gemini
notes: OpenAI-compat is beta; Bearer auth; function calling supported. Native docs now lead with the Interactions API (v1beta/interactions, header x-goog-api-key). Legacy models/{m}:generateContent endpoint unverified in current docs. Gemini 4 / 3.6+ ignore temperature/top_p/top_k.

name: xAI (Grok)
notes: Bearer auth. Chat Completions labelled 'legacy'; Responses API preferred. Only one current chat model ID verified (grok-4.7, 500k context); add others after checking docs.x.ai/docs/models. Docs branded 'SpaceXSI'.

name: Mistral AI
notes: Bearer auth; base confirmed by curl example in API reference. tool_choice also accepts 'any'. mistral-large-4 (v26.10) is public preview; aliases mistral-large-latest / mistral-medium-latest documented. Key URL is console root (exact keys page unverified).

name: Groq
notes: Bearer auth. Rejects logprobs, logit_bias, messages[].name. Also openai/gpt-oss-20b; qwen/qwen3.8-27b is preview.

name: Together AI
notes: Bearer auth. Also MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3, Qwen/Qwen3.7-Plus.

name: Fireworks AI
notes: Bearer auth; OpenAI-compatible tool calling confirmed (tool_choice auto/none/required/specific). Model IDs use accounts/fireworks/models/ prefix. Exact keys page URL unverified (dashboard root given).

name: OpenRouter
notes: Bearer auth. Optional HTTP-Referer and X-OpenRouter-Title headers for app attribution. '~' slugs are latest-aliases; full catalog via GET /api/v1/models. Key URL unverified.

name: DeepSeek
notes: Bearer auth; base has no /v1 (curl uses https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions). deepseek-flash is served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; legacy deepseek-v4-flash names still accepted. Thinking via thinking:{type:enabled} + reasoning_effort. Tool-calling support not re-verified on a fetched page this session (unverified).

name: Moonshot AI (Kimi)
notes: Bearer auth; China base and tools confirmed on Chat Completions reference. K3 series always thinks (reasoning_effort low/high/max) and assistant reasoning_content must be echoed back in multi-turn/tool loops. Messages (Anthropic-style) and Responses APIs also exist; their base paths unverified. Global .ai host unverified.

name: Zhipu AI (GLM / BigModel)
notes: Bearer auth. temperature must be in (0,1); 0 not allowed in OpenAI mode. Thinking via extra_body thinking:{type:enabled}. A Claude-compatible API exists (URL unverified). Z.ai global host unverified.

name: Alibaba Qwen (Model Studio / DashScope)
notes: Bearer auth. Docs recommend per-workspace domains; legacy dashscope(-intl) domains 'still work'. API keys are region-bound (wrong region -> 401 invalid_api_key). Docs' param table says tools supported on qwen-plus/qwen-max and 'cannot be used with stream=True' (may be stale text). Only two current model IDs seen.

name: Baidu Qianfan (ERNIE)
notes: POST /v2/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer bce-v3/ALTAK-... API key. Tools/tool_choice/parallel_tool_calls supported per model list. Only model ID shown on the page is deepseek-v3.1-250821; current ERNIE model IDs unverified (see cloud.baidu.com/doc/qianfan/s/rmh4stp0j). Key URL unverified.

name: Volcengine Ark (Doubao)
notes: Doubao via Volcengine Ark. Use the model or endpoint ID from your Ark console.

name: Tencent Hunyuan
notes: Bearer auth. tool_choice only effective on hunyuan-turbos / hunyuan-functioncall. stop behaves differently (stops after match). Default 5 concurrent requests. Tencent is migrating Hunyuan to TokenHub; no new purchases on old platform, so this preset may age out.

name: MiniMax
notes: Bearer auth. Anthropic SDK is MiniMax's recommended path (base URL unverified). temperature/top_p ignored; n=1 only; legacy function_call unsupported (use tools). M3.1-Flash always thinks; reasoning_content must be preserved in tool loops. Key page URL approximate (console).

name: StepFun
notes: Bearer auth. Taken from official StepFun doc search excerpts (pages not fully fetched). Step Plan subscriptions use /step_plan/v1 instead. Key URL is the global console page.

name: 01.AI (Yi)
notes: Unverified: 01.AI docs were unreachable. Enter a model name from your 01.AI console.

name: Perplexity
notes: Bearer auth. Chat Completions format lives on the Orchestrator API (open-weight models). Agent API uses /v1/agent (alias /v1/responses), not chat/completions. Function-calling support on Orchestrator unverified, so tools=false.

name: Cohere
notes: Bearer auth on both. Compat: reasoning_effort only none/high; unsupported n, logit_bias, parallel_tool_calls, top_logprobs etc. Native uses p/k instead of top_p, tool_choice REQUIRED/NONE, strict_tools beta. Only one current chat model ID seen. Key URL unverified.

name: Ollama
notes: Local: API key required by SDK but ignored. Tools supported on /v1/chat/completions. Models depend on what the user has pulled. Also has an Anthropic-compat endpoint.

name: LM Studio
notes: No key by default (optional auth exists). Default port 1234. Models are whatever is loaded locally; fetch via GET /v1/models. Tool Use page exists in docs. Also exposes Anthropic-compat /v1/messages.

name: Custom (any OpenAI-compatible)
notes: Any server that speaks /chat/completions: vLLM, llama.cpp, LiteLLM, a company gateway.

name: Custom (Anthropic-compatible)
notes: Any server that speaks the Anthropic /messages API (DeepSeek, MiniMax and Kimi offer one).
